title: Certificate check

headline.no_longer_valid: This certificate is no longer valid

lead.valid: EU Jobs issued this certificate to {{name}} for completing a course and passing its final assessment.
lead.revoked: EU Jobs revoked this certificate on {{date}}. It no longer confirms that the course was completed.

previewCaption: A preview of the certificate. The holder keeps the PDF; this page checks it against the EU Jobs record.
how: This page reads the certificate’s record from EU Jobs each time it opens. If a certificate is revoked, it shows here as revoked, whatever the PDF says.
noLongerValid: This certificate was issued on EU Jobs but is no longer valid.
note: A certificate confirms that a course was completed and its final quiz passed on EU Jobs. It does not verify workplace skills.

notFound.title: No certificate with this code
notFound.text: Check the code on the certificate. Codes look like EUJ-7K3P-Q9XD.
